0022600194.text: The Phoenix Suns (2-5, 12th in the West) host the Houston Rockets (7-2, 1st in the Southwest) in the Suns' eighth game of the season, with Phoenix 0-3 on the road and 2-2 at home, while Houston has lost its most recent game after going 7-2 over its last ten. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), and Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Houston is missing Clint Capela (out, ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (out, calf strain). The teams have not played each other yet this season, following a 2025-26 season series in which the Suns lost 0-4 and an April 7 meeting in Phoenix that Phoenix lost 119-105.
